name: io.github.lottshin/dingcard
title: DingCard
description: Make posters, social cards and slide decks from templates, check the layout, render PNG, JPG or PDF

environmentVariables.name: DINGCARD_FONTS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where to download web fonts instead of https://fonts.googleapis.com, e.g. https://fonts.googleapis.cn

environmentVariables.name: DINGCARD_CHROME_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to Chrome when it is not installed in the usual place (used for checks and renders)

environmentVariables.name: DINGCARD_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: A deployed DingCard server, for share links and saved projects

environmentVariables.name: DINGCARD_SERVER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token for DINGCARD_SERVER_URL (scopes: images and shares; drafts for projects)
